rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: War-leader manifestation frightening enemies and urging warriors forward.

visual_requirements.description: Human female war-leader manifestation in opaque editorial ancient clothes/armor, no hybrid crow anatomy.
Encourages warriors and strikes fear into enemies; reactions visible rather than magical beams.
Battlefield of goddess of battle and war.

aura: Keagungan lewat manifestasi pemimpin perang dan efek ketakutan nyata pada musuh (the-morrigan-c07, the-morrigan-c02), tanpa aura generik.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.

Warleader variant selected over crow to avoid ordinary bird; no hybrid transformation anatomy inferred. Editorial ancient clothes and armor lack modern franchise identifiers. Fear/encouragement visible via human reactions, not invented elemental spell.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of THE MORRÍGAN, Irish goddess of battle and fate, in her documented WAR-LEADER manifestation [the-morrigan-c07].
ANATOMY: ONE mature human female war leader, one head, two arms, two legs; severe weathered pale face and fierce dark eyes, black hair wind-torn, fully opaque rough dark wool cloak and leather/bronze ancient war clothing, no horns, no wings, no hybrid bird limbs, no invented crown. Clothing/armor is editorial visualization of war leader, not film character.
MOMENT: lunging forward into the battle with torso sharply turned, mouth open in an overwhelming commanding cry, one arm thrust forward pointing into enemy ranks and the other hauling a heavy cloak aside; near face and hand command the foreground, NOT a fashion portrait or neutral standing woman.
POWER: she ENCOURAGES her warriors while STRIKING FEAR into enemies [the-morrigan-c02]: behind one shoulder her armed followers surge forward with raised spears; directly beneath her outstretched hand an enemy warrior recoils backward, dropping shield, eyes wide and visibly terrified. No aura, magic beam, fire, lightning or telekinesis; divine effect is the documented fear visibly acting on people.
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low close perspective, goddess fills most square with larger-than-life composition but NO invented giant bodily scale; other warriors behind her are normal-scale perspective, not tiny toys.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dying sun behind dark battlefield cloud rims hair and bronze cloth clasps; deep shadows, dust from combat.
SURFACE: wind-tangled black hair, weathered bronze, coarse opaque wool, churned battlefield mud.
SETTING: ancient Irish battlefield, spear-armed warriors without modern insignia [the-morrigan-c01,c03,c08].
MOOD: awe-inspiring terrifying sacred war command, respect for deity, intense active moment.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
